local_search.decision: Use inspected primary standards plus author-hosted OSTEP chapters; library filename discoveries alone do not authorize chapter claims.

reflection: Keep the boot ABI distinct from hosted C startup.
Prefer a precisely bounded modern virtio transport over a copied production driver.
Preserve runtime/store implementation ownership; only adapters and integration are new.
An older exactly inspected Intel passage is labeled historical, not silently presented as revision 093.
limitations: No SMP or POSIX/general ELF conformance
QEMU reboot is not physical power-cut certification
